WITH invoice_stats AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS average_quantity,
    SUM(derived_product_cost) AS total_product_cost,
    SUM(derived_total_cost) AS total_total_cost
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS overall_average_quantity
  FROM invoice_stats
)
SELECT
  s.invoice_number,
  s.average_quantity,
  (s.total_product_cost - s.total_total_cost) / s.total_total_cost AS cost_ratio,
  s.average_quantity - o.overall_average_quantity AS quantity_difference
FROM invoice_stats AS s
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE s.average_quantity > o.overall_average_quantity
ORDER BY quantity_difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
